Blujepa (gepotidacin) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-681270  
Guideline Name 
Blujepa (gepotidacin)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Blujepa  
Diagnosis 
Uncomplicated Urinary Tract Infection (uUTI)  
Approval Length 
5 Day(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of an uncomplicated urinary tract infection (uUTI)  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 250 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 250 
 
2 - Patient is 12 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient weighs at least 40 kg (kilograms)  
 
AND 
 
4 - Trial and inadequate response, contraindication, or resistance to BOTH of the following 
alternative oral antibacterial treatment options:  
• 
ciprofloxacin  
• 
nitrofurantoin  
 
AND 
 
5 - Infection is caused by ONE of the following:  
• 
Escherichia coli  
• 
Klebsiella pneumoniae  
• 
Citrobacter freundii complex  
• 
Staphylococcus saprophyticus  
• 
Enterococcus faecalis  
 
Product Name:Blujepa  
Diagnosis 
Uncomplicated Urogenital Gonorrhea  
Approval Length 
3 Day(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhea susceptible to gepotidacin  


--- PDF page 251 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 251 
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 12 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient weighs at least 45 kg (kilograms)  
 
AND 
 
4 - Trial and inadequate response, contraindication, or resistance to ONE of the following 
alternative antibacterial treatment options:  
• 
ceftriaxone  
• 
ceftriaxone plus azithromycin

Date  
Notes

ogenital gonorrhea criteria sections.
